items.title: Dover (DOV) Stock May Be Below Fair Value On Cash Flow
items.summary: Dover shares have climbed over the past few years, yet the recent pullback leaves a straightforward question on the table: Is the current US$186.54 price still aligned with the cash flows that the business is expected to generate? The stock has risen 38.0% over the past 3 years, which puts real weight on whether that move is fully backed by the cash the company can produce. Steady execution in industrial equipment and related services can support predictable cash generation, which matters...
